verdict: FactSet grew revenue 6.3% to $634.7 million and pushed organic subscription value up 7.0%, but restructuring and other one-time costs cut GAAP operating income 11.7% to $156.6 million.

segments.name: Americas
segments.note: Subscription data and analytics sold to clients in the Americas — FactSet's home and largest market.

segments.name: EMEA
segments.note: Europe, the Middle East and Africa — the second-largest region for subscription revenue.

segments.name: APAC
segments.note: Asia-Pacific — the smallest but fastest-growing region this quarter.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Sales, marketing and the back office — including higher ASV-linked incentive pay and one-time restructuring charges this quarter.

otherDetail: Interest expense of $14.4M, partly offset by $1.4M of interest income and $0.7M of other income — a net $12.3M cost as reported (shown rounded here).

takeaways.title: Subscriptions keep compounding
takeaways.text: Organic annual subscription value (ASV) — the forward revenue locked in from subscriptions — rose 7.0% to $2,568.2M, a record increase, with retention above 95%.

takeaways.title: GAAP margin took a one-time hit
takeaways.text: GAAP operating margin fell to 24.7% from 29.7% a year ago, mainly on $26.9M of restructuring/severance and $4.6M of CEO onboarding costs. Adjusted margin was 33.0%.

takeaways.title: Cash still flows, and gets returned
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $177.3M in the quarter, and FactSet returned over $179M to shareholders — $138M of buybacks plus more than $41M of dividends.

oneTimers: Restructuring and severance charges of $26.9M and CEO onboarding costs of $4.6M weighed on GAAP operating income; excluding them and intangible amortization, adjusted operating income was $209.4M, up 3.8%.

A year ago, results included a gain on the divestiture of a business, which makes this year's GAAP EPS comparison ($3.41 vs $4.03) look worse than the underlying trend — adjusted EPS rose 11.6% to $4.52.

sources.label: Official earnings release (Globe Newswire, as furnished to the SEC)

footerNote: FactSet reports a single operating-expense section; cost of services is shown as the direct-cost block and selling, general & administrative as the running-cost block. Segment growth rates are organic revenue growth as reported. Figures are rounded to the nearest $0.1M from the release's thousands.
